name: Binary-first executable CLI
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "crates/sens-cli/src/main.rs"
      - "crates/sens/src/canonical_reader.rs"
      - "crates/sens/src/source_words.rs"
      - ".github/workflows/binary-first-cli.yml"
      - "docs/binary-first-cli.uk.md"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "crates/sens-cli/src/main.rs"
      - "crates/sens/src/canonical_reader.rs"
      - "crates/sens/src/source_words.rs"
      - ".github/workflows/binary-first-cli.yml"
      - "docs/binary-first-cli.uk.md"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  binary-source-boundary:
    name: strict binary parser and CLI smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Verify binary CLI tests (no semantic oracle shortcuts)
        run: cargo test --locked -p sens-cli --bin sens binary_cli_ -- --nocapture
      - name: Verify exact-word parser
        run: cargo test --locked -p sens --test domain_ladder
      - name: Machine-only source is accepted without bootstrap
        run: |
          printf '10 001 00 000 01\n' | cargo run --locked --quiet -p sens-cli --bin sens -- --binary-check -
      - name: Human names and damaged binary are rejected (no fallback)
        run: |
          if printf '(CONS x y)\n' | cargo run --locked --quiet -p sens-cli --bin sens -- --binary-check -; then
            echo "FAIL: human syntax entered exact binary reader" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if printf '10 001 00 000\n' | cargo run --locked --quiet -p sens-cli --bin sens -- --binary-check -; then
            echo "FAIL: malformed D2 frame admitted" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if printf '1111111111\n' | cargo run --locked --quiet -p sens-cli --bin sens -- --binary-check -; then
            echo "FAIL: invalid 10-bit coordinate admitted" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
